name: Resistance Zone Rejection
market_conditions: price approaching a well-established resistance zone
resistance zone has been tested and rejected at least twice previously
broader trend is neutral to bearish or price is in a range
no major bullish catalyst or news event imminent
resistance zone is not in a steeply rising trend where it is likely to break
phase_requirements: retracement phase rallying into resistance in a downtrend
upper boundary of a range in distribution phase
not during aggressive markup phase where resistance is likely to break
entry_conditions: price reaches or tags the resistance zone boundary
rejection candle forms at the resistance zone: shooting star, pin bar, bearish engulfing, or gravestone doji
upper wick of rejection candle penetrates into the zone but candle closes below it
volume on rejection candle is above the 10-period average
RSI is at or approaching overbought region (55-70 range) on the entry timeframe
confirmation_requirements: rejection candle closes below the resistance zone midpoint
follow-through candle in the bearish direction confirms the rejection
volume on follow-through candle is above average
RSI turning downward from the 55-70 zone
price does not close above the resistance zone on any subsequent candle before entry
MACD histogram shows reducing bullish momentum or bearish cross near the zone
stop_loss_logic: Place stop loss above the highest wick that tagged the resistance zone, plus a 0.5-1 ATR buffer above the zone's upper boundary. The stop must be above a level that would definitively invalidate the resistance zone.
take_profit_logic: First target at the most recent swing low or support level below. Second target at the lower boundary of the range or prior structural low. Take partial profit at 1:1 RR and trail the rest with a 20 EMA on the entry timeframe.
invalidation_conditions: price closes above the resistance zone upper boundary with a full bullish candle body
high volume bullish candle breaks through the zone indicating institutional buying
multiple consecutive candles close inside or above the zone without rejecting
RSI breaks above 75 indicating strong momentum rather than a rejection setup
a gap up through the resistance zone on the open
broader market index breaks to new highs simultaneously

required_features.resistance_zone_quality: tested at least twice, clear zone boundaries
required_features.rejection_candle: present at zone with long upper wick
required_features.zone_proximity: price within zone boundaries or tagging upper boundary

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D or 4H to identify and qualify the resistance zone
timeframe_requirements.entry: 1H or 15M to spot the rejection candle and time the entry

risk_notes: Resistance zones weaken each time they are tested. A third or fourth test of a resistance zone has a higher chance of breaking out. Always check if the broader trend is against you. A resistance rejection trade in a strong uptrend carries higher risk of a false rejection. Ensure the resistance zone is drawn from significant swing highs, not arbitrary levels. Do not risk more than 1.5% on any single resistance rejection trade.

agent_rules.rule: Only trade resistance zones that have been validated by at least two prior rejections.
Require a rejection candle with a prominent upper wick at the zone — a plain bullish close is not sufficient.
If price closes a full candle body above the resistance zone, exit the trade immediately — do not wait for a drop.
Check the macro timeframe (1D) before entering — if the daily trend is strongly bullish, require additional confluences.
Move stop to breakeven after price travels 1 ATR from entry in the intended direction.
If the same resistance zone has been tested more than 3 times, treat it as likely to break rather than reject — reduce position size or skip.
